details:
(Using DeepL translate)
Hello.
I am looking forward to the "save and load world data" feature you announced for 2021.
So I have a few suggestions.
I know it is still a long way off, but I would appreciate it if you could take a look at them.
[Sharing save data with other worlds]
If we use the save feature, many people will want to use it for games that can be played on VRChat.
Some creators may want to create something like an MMORPG. (I would like to do the same).
However, this would bloat the capacity of the world and require the world to be split up (as in Virtual Market).
So, my suggestion is to add an option to "share save data with specified world IDs".
This will allow for distribution of world load as mentioned above.
[sub-world function]
This is a proposal related to the "share save data with other worlds" feature mentioned above.
・Allow users to arbitrarily set a world ID that is the main world.
・Add a tag to the details of the set world to indicate that it is a sub-world.
This will indicate that the world is not the "entry point" and will not be
This will prevent confusion in narrative game worlds.
Best regards. Thanks again for all your hard work.
title: Suggestion regarding save/load functionality for worlds
